# WTAP

> Regional news coverage focused on environmental initiatives, local education, corporate developments, and community stories from West Virginia and surrounding areas.

WTAP provides local and regional news reporting with emphasis on environmental policy, education funding, and economic developments affecting the Mid-Atlantic region. The site covers institutional announcements, school district initiatives, and corporate news impacting the local community.

## Key Topics

- EPA grants
- Clean School Bus Rebate Program
- electric school buses
- Wirt County Schools
- West Virginia
- clean energy
- environmental initiatives
- Dupont
- Dow Chemical
- corporate restructuring
- job cuts
- Delaware
- school districts
- student health

- [Wirt County Schools received electric bus through EPA grant](https://www.wtap.com/2023/09/15/wirt-county-schools-received-electric-bus-through-epa-grant/): Wirt County Schools receives electric bus via EPA Clean School Bus Rebate Program
- [Athens native wins SEC Championship](https://www.wtap.com/content/news/Athens-native-wins-SEC-Championship--565935651.html): Joe Burrow from Athens wins SEC Championship with LSU Tigers football
